description: This file provides database connection utilities for a Python project, specifically using psycopg to connect to a PostgreSQL database. It includes functions to build connection URLs from environment variables, retrieve database settings, and execute queries.

classes.name: DatabaseSettings
classes.description: Dataclass encapsulating database connection settings, primarily the database URL.

methods.name: str _normalize_postgres_url(url: str)
methods.description: Converts 'postgres://' URLs to 'postgresql://' format for compatibility with psycopg.

methods.name: str _build_postgres_url_from_env()
methods.description: Constructs a PostgreSQL connection URL based on environment variables, with normalization and error handling.

methods.name: DatabaseSettings get_db_settings()
methods.description: Retrieves database configuration settings from environment variables.

methods.name: psycopg.Connection get_connection()
methods.description: Establishes and returns a new psycopg database connection using the settings.

methods.name: Optional[dict] fetch_one(conn: psycopg.Connection, query: str, params: Optional[dict] = None)
methods.description: Executes a query and fetches a single result row as a dictionary.

methods.name: list[dict] fetch_all(conn: psycopg.Connection, query: str, params: Optional[dict] = None)
methods.description: Executes a query and fetches all result rows as a list of dictionaries.

methods.name: int execute(conn: psycopg.Connection, query: str, params: Optional[dict] = None)
methods.description: Executes a statement and returns the number of affected rows.

ctags.signature: (conn: psycopg.Connection, query: str, params: Optional[dict] = None)
